method: Agent-assisted reading of retained official PDFs; founder review required. All document hashes and current index associations must match before drafts receive these fields.
openingDateNote: The Government of Goa CBES application portal explicitly prints 11-09-2026 as Start Date of Application and 02-10-2026 as Last Date of Application for each of the four post pages. Neither portal nor checked PDFs prints a cutoff clock time or governing timezone.
cycleIdentityEvidence: Advertisement 3/2026, scheme clause 4.1, printed page 15, and general instructions section 1(c) require separate application for each post. Departments and vacancies within one post do not multiply application cycles.
conflicts: PwD application fee conflict: advertisement 3/2026 page 11 says Nil; general instructions section 3 lists INR 50/100 by pay level. Founder must resolve before publication.

CBES application portal still lists 111 UR and 204 total LDC/Recovery Clerk vacancies, while GSSC supplementary note 21/09/2026 changes these to 110 UR and 203 total. Treat supplementary notice as latest count; founder must resolve stale portal display before publication.
amendmentNotes: Supplementary note 21/09/2026 changes LDC/Recovery Clerk total from 204 to 203 and UR total from 111 to 110. Original brief notice had tentative counts; it is not authoritative for final totals.
Supplementary note replaces scheme 5.1: CBT-II shortlisting is 15 times for posts 1 and 3, 5 times for posts 2 and 4.

posts.title: Desktop Publishing Operator
posts.qualifications: Higher Secondary School Certificate; NCVT training in Desktop Publishing Operator or the specified apprenticeship certificate; three years of printing/publishing experience; practical layout, word-processing and Corel Draw knowledge; Devnagri software knowledge. English typing at 40 words per minute and knowledge of Konkani are essential. Marathi knowledge is desirable, not an automatic exclusion. Advertisement clause (5), page 11, exempts candidates with benchmark disabilities from essential experience; verify the cited order and post conditions.
posts.residenceRule: Advertisement 3/2026 clause (8), page 11, requires a valid 15-year Goa residence certificate and Goa Employment Exchange registration. General instructions section 8(a) states residence in Goa for the last 15 years with a competent-authority certificate. Verify applicable service-rule exceptions and documents; current residence alone cannot prove this condition.
posts.fee: UR INR 400; SC/ST INR 100; OBC/EWS INR 200. Advertisement clause (6) lists PwD fee as Nil; linked general instructions section 3 still lists a PwD fee. Conflict requires confirmation before payment.
posts.salary: Pay Level 5; monetary salary not extracted.
